importModal.title: Import a card
importModal.intro: Bring in a character or scenario made elsewhere. Cards follow the Character Card V2 and V3 formats, which most roleplay tools read and write. Everything a card holds is kept, even what Evermind does not use.
importModal.acceptsPng: A PNG card, artwork included. The card is read from inside the image.
importModal.acceptsJson: A JSON card exported from another tool.
importModal.acceptsLorebook: An attached lorebook comes along with it.
importModal.dropHint: or click to choose one. Several at once is fine.
importModal.sizeNote: Up to 15 MB per file. Nothing is uploaded anywhere: the file is read by your own copy of Evermind.
importModal.maybeMade: A copy of this card may be on the home page already: look there before importing it again.

settings.subtitle: Your models, your rules: Evermind connects to the AI you choose.
settings.replyLengthHint: Applies to every conversation. Evermind keeps the room needed by the AIs it sets itself; an AI with a fixed ceiling may cut long replies: see My AIs.
settings.historyLimitLabel: Recent messages sent to the model
settings.historyLimitHint: Beyond this, older turns only live on in the summary and established facts. Short window (16–30): the model stays focused on instructions instead of imitating its own replies. Long window: more raw continuity, but small models start to ramble.
settings.passageBudgetHint: Retrieves verbatim excerpts from older messages that are semantically related to the current scene (requires the "semantic" extra). ~1500 ≈ 10% of a 16k context. Set to 0 to disable. Every recall token is one less token of recent history.

autoMemoryHint.after: and updates the summary every ~6 replies. Facts stay visible and editable in each conversation's panel.

globalInstructionsHint.part1: Added to every conversation, after the character's rules. This is where you set
globalInstructionsHint.part3: limits: style, length, themes, language. Evermind imposes nothing.

settings.globalInstructionsPlaceholder:
E.g.: Always reply in English. Replies of 2 paragraphs maximum.
Stay dark and realistic, never ask my permission to move the story forward.

directive.title: Scene directive
directive.description: A standing instruction reminded to the AI on every reply. It's the strongest lever for correcting a stubborn tic ("always finish your sentences", "vary your phrasing", "stay explicit"…).
directive.placeholder: E.g.: every reply must be a complete sentence, never leave a character hanging mid-thought.

facts.description: Canon the character must not contradict. Pinned facts are always sent to the model; the others only once their turn has left the recent messages, and within a budget. Extracted automatically as the story goes.

reread.title: This card was made before Evermind kept cards whole.
reread.added: Will be added or brought up to date:
reread.untouched: Will stay as you left it:
reread.changes: What will change in its conversations:

change.budget: The lorebook gets a share of the context rather than a fixed size.
change.order: Entries are placed by their order and their place, before or after the description.
change.wholeWords: Keywords only find whole words, unless an entry says otherwise.
change.recursion: An entry's text can call other entries.
change.examples: Example dialogues are sent as separate blocks.
change.instructions: The card's own end-of-context instructions take the place of the role reminder.
change.macros: Marks such as random picks and dice rolls are replaced.
change.depth: The note and the entries set at a depth go into a turn of the person, marked as not theirs.

reread.left: {count:grouped} lorebook entries stay as they are: Evermind could not tell for sure which entry of the card they come from, or you wrote them here.
reread.left_one: {count:grouped} lorebook entry stays as it is: Evermind could not tell for sure which entry of the card it comes from, or you wrote it here.
reread.reread: Re-read the card and switch to the new rules
reread.keep: Keep only the original card for the export
reread.keepHint: Keeping it changes nothing in its conversations; this notice stays, to switch to the new rules later.

Shorten it, raise its reading capacity in My AIs, under Advanced, if the model can take more, or choose an AI that reads more.
errors.cardTooLong: What this card already holds is too long for this model: with the assistant's instructions and room for its answer, it needs about {needed:grouped} tokens, and this AI reads {context:grouped} at a time. errors.contextTooSmall: This model's context is too small for the card assistant: its instructions and room for a card alone need about {needed:grouped} tokens, and this AI reads {context:grouped} at a time.
